name: zzbd_manager_flush_temp_stream_to_section_record
description: zZbdManager::FlushTempStreamToSectionRecord copies a CRT temp stream into a section-data buffer, writes it as a ZBD section record, frees the buffer, and removes temp streams.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x4c0700 calls fflush, fseek(SEEK_END), ftell, rewind, malloc(dataSize), fread(sectionData, dataSize, 1, tempStream), zZbdManager::WriteSectionRecord(callbackCtx, sectionToken, sectionData, dataSize), free(sectionData), then _rmtmp.
